visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair wearing a white t-shirt sits on a brown leather couch in a modern living room. He looks directly at the camera, talking and gesturing with his hands. Behind him is a wall with many photos and postcards. (2) The man attempts to sing, initially keeping his face relatively neutral. He then performs a second attempt where he raises his eyebrows extremely high, causing deep wrinkles on his forehead while opening his mouth wide. (3) A woman with long dark hair in a black top is now on the same couch. She sings a line, first with a normal expression, and then a second time with her eyes rolled upwards and eyebrows arched dramatically. (4) The first man returns, using both index fingers to physically push his eyebrows up while singing with a strained facial expression. (5) A second man in a grey t-shirt joins the group on the couch. He sings with high energy. During his attempt, animated yellow screaming chicken graphics appear near his face. (6) A second woman with bangs and an off-the-shoulder black top tries the technique. She holds her hair back and raises her eyebrows while singing. An animated kettle with steam appears near her head as she hits a high note. (7) The group is seen laughing together in a brightly lit indoor environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A man speaks in a friendly, conversational tone in Mandarin, explaining a singing tip. No background music is present. (2) The man begins singing a high-pitched English phrase ("Like I'm born to be"). His voice sounds strained and thin at the high register. A female voice laughs in the background. (3) A female voice sings the same English line. Her pitch is much higher and clearer. A comical 'ding' sound effect plays. (4) Laughter erupts from multiple people. A second male voice sings with high energy and loud volume, resulting in a comical vocal slide. (5) Another female voice attempts the high note but her voice breaks comically, followed by a 'pop' sound effect. The entire group bursts into loud, joyful laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous challenge or experiment where a group of friends tests a singing tip attributed to the singer G.E.M. (Deng Ziqi). The tip suggests that raising one's eyebrows while singing increases mouth space and resonance. The video documents each person's attempt to sing a difficult high note while making exaggerated facial expressions, primarily for comedic effect and to see if the tip actually works for them.
